title: Resolve postponed annotations when inspecting command signatures
answers: Why do commands from modules using future annotations fail to execute?
How should command signatures handle string annotations?
body:
Symptom: Commands from modules using `from __future__ import annotations` fail to execute.
Root cause: Signature inspection in mitmproxy/command.py:Command and mitmproxy/command.py:verify_arg_signature did not evaluate string annotations.
Fix pattern: Use `inspect.signature(..., eval_str=True)` when constructing command signatures and inspecting callables for argument verification.
Constraints: Applies to command signature inspection with postponed annotations; preserve the existing argument-binding validation via `sig.bind(*args, **kwargs)`.
applies: Command construction and argument verification for command callables with postponed annotations.
